description:
fuel_entry stores only protein_g and calories (apps/api/src/db/schema/tracker.ts:198-209), and nutrition_target only those two (:217-227).

SCHEMA
- fuel_entry.carbs_g, fuel_entry.fat_g: real, NULLABLE. Null means "not given", not zero, the same blank-is-not-zero rule readAmount already enforces on the client (apps/web/src/lib/fuel.ts, Amount). No backfill: every existing row honestly did not record them.
- nutrition_target.carbs_g, nutrition_target.fat_g: integer, NULLABLE. Null means no target. The table stays append-only.

API / CONTRACT (@afya/shared)
- FuelEntry, AddFuelEntryBody/UpdateFuelEntryBody and NutritionTarget gain carbsG/fatG as number | null. readFuelFields (apps/api/src/routes/fuel.ts) parses them, keeping null distinct from 0.
- FuelDay.totals and FuelHistoryDay gain carbsG/fatG plus a count of entries missing each. A total over partial data must be able to say so ("156 g · +1 not given").
- canLogAmounts still requires only protein or calories. Carbs and fat never gate logging.

WEB
Four-macro summary on the Fuel page (mockup board Main). The custom-add and edit forms get two optional fields with "not given" placeholders. A macro with no target shows no bar rather than an empty one.

RULES 5: read and write paths land together in this change.

Mockup (deleted; this text is the spec) (Main, Log › Just numbers).
title: Track carbs and fat, optional on every entry, with optional targets
